get.summary: The Openings screen: repertoire tree, ECO families, top openings.
get.description: Where the repertoire wins and leaks points. The repertoire tree is embedded whole for both colors (the web's As White / As Black toggle is a client-side switch, not a parameter), and every branch carries the Games that reached it, so drilling into a branch needs no second request. Forfeits are excluded from every section (one forced move is not repertoire data).

200.description: The Openings screen for this filter state.

OpeningsPayload.description: Everything the Openings page shows. An empty repertoire tree for a color (game_count 0) is that color's empty state; empty eco_families / top_openings arrays are the chart and table empty states. Source: pages/openings.py update_repertoire -> pgn_stats_core.repertoire_tree (called once per color); update_opening_family and update_opening_table -> pgn_stats_core.opening_summary.

games_count.description: Games after filters (Forfeits included; the sections below drop them).

eco_families.description: The Win rate by ECO family stacked bar chart, most-played family first. Games with no ECO are left out.

top_openings.description: The Top openings table: one row per (ECO, Opening) pair, most-played first, the first 50 rows (opening_summary(...)[1].head(50)).

OpeningsRepertoireTree.description: Every Game as one color (Forfeits and move-less Games excluded), arranged move by move. The header line reads '<game_count> games, <score_pct>% overall score. Branches scoring below that across <min_games>+ games are flagged.'

game_count.description: Games in this tree. 0 is the 'No games as <color> in this filter' empty state.

score_pct.description: The baseline every branch is judged against: the chess score as this color, 0..100 (wins 1, draws 0.5), one decimal. 0 when game_count is 0.

min_games.description: How many Games a branch needs before it can be flagged (3 today).

moves.description: First-move nodes, most-played first, ties alphabetical by SAN.

OpeningsRepertoireNode.description: One move of the repertoire tree. A node with game_count 1 is a leaf the web renders as a single row linking straight to games[0]; it never has children. A node with several Games expands into its child moves plus the Games that ended here. The score marker (above / at / below baseline) is score_pct compared with the tree's score_pct; the client derives it.

san.description: The move in SAN, e.g. Nf6.

ply.description: 1-based half-move number. The web label is '<(ply+1)//2>. <san>' for odd plies and '<(ply+1)//2>... <san>' for even ones.

score_pct.description: This branch's chess score, 0..100, one decimal.

underperforming.description: The leaking-points flag: true when game_count >= min_games and score_pct is below the tree's baseline score_pct.

games.description: Every Game that reached this position: the drill-down list for the branch.

ended_here.description: The subset of games whose move list stops at exactly this position (the web's 'ended here' rows). Games that kept going are reached through moves.

moves.description: The next moves, most-played first. Always empty when game_count is 1.

OpeningsGameRef.description: A compact link to one Game, rendered '<outcome> vs <opponent>'. Tap opens GET /api/v1/games/{game_id}.

OpeningsEcoFamily.description: One bar of the ECO family chart (stacked Win/Draw/Loss counts; the hover shows each count).

family_name.description: The axis label, e.g. 'B: Semi-Open'; an unknown letter reads '<letter>: Other'.

OpeningsOpening.description: One row of the Top openings table.

opening.description: The PGN Opening header; empty when unset.

win_rate_pct.description: Wins / games, 0..100, one decimal (the web's Win % column).
